answer: Lineage Ledger. Each agent inherits an append-only key chain from its parent; every operation must reference the prior link, so copies fork visibly at the split point. An orchard of duplicate agents produces conflicting branches that counterparties detect on first contact. The relic of each genesis record stays unique and unforgeable. Attackers must buy distinct genuine lineages, and each costs a full onboarding cycle plus lost reputation history — a vine that cannot be grafted twice.
